title: fix(react): mark the field a unique-index refusal names in create/edit forms
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8FFTSFXvg3gyNdUibNK8VkN)_
Fixes #26891

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`@object-ui/react` 的 `extractFieldErrors` 现在识别 409 `UNIQUE_VIOLATION` 里单个 `field`,返回一条带服务端句子的字段错误;表单因此把重复值标在对应输入框下。
- 为什么改:服务端(#26867)已在拒绝里点名字段并用标签造句,但前端只读字段数组,唯一索引冲突仍只显示横幅加 toast,用户要猜是哪个字段重复。
- 风险与回滚:只在 `code` 为 `UNIQUE_VIOLATION` 且带字符串 `field` 时生效;无 `field`(复合索引、索引名)照旧走横幅。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/react/src/utils/error-message.ts` 的 `extractFieldErrors` 新分支;`form-server-field-errors.test.tsx` 新增的 unique-index 两例。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/react/src/utils/error-message.test.ts packages/components/src/renderers/form/__tests__/form-server-field-errors.test.tsx`,预期全绿;在 console 新建一个 SKU 重复的产品,SKU 输入框下出现 "A record with this SKU already exists",无 toast。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `extractFieldErrors` (`@object-ui/react`): when no field-error list is present and the refusal's code is `UNIQUE_VIOLATION` (read from `code`, then `details.code`, the same pair `isPermissionError` reads), the single string `field` (`details.field` on the raw `@objectstack/client` error, `field` on a hand-rolled one) becomes one `WriteFieldError` whose message is the server's sentence (`extractWriteErrorMessage`). Without `field` the answer stays `null`.
- No change to `form.tsx`: its existing `extractFieldErrors` then `form.setError` path marks the input, and a fully attributed refusal shows no banner and no toast.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/react` patch.

## Why

The server half shipped in #26867: the 409 `UNIQUE_VIOLATION` body is `{ error, code, developerMessage?, field?, object? }`, with `error` naming the field by its label. `@objectstack/client` parks that flat body on `err.details`, and `normaliseClientError` (`@object-ui/data-objectstack`) passes a unique 409 through unchanged. The last hop read only arrays (`validationErrors`, `details.fields`, `fields`), so it answered `null` and the dialog showed the generic banner and toast.

Side effect, measured: `InlineEditSaveBar` (`@object-ui/plugin-detail`) calls the same helper, so on the atomic save path a unique refusal with `field` is now attributed to that field (labelled in the bar and published as the per-field hint) instead of the generic text; in callback mode it was already attributed to the in-flight field. Its suites stay green (below).

## Tests

- `error-message.test.ts`: a unique refusal with `field` yields one entry carrying the server's sentence (asserts `code` and `httpStatus` 409 on the refusal); a hand-rolled one with top-level `field`; without `field` it answers `null`; an `INVALID_FIELD` carrying `field` still answers `null`.
- `error-message.normalisation-boundary.test.ts`: the refusal survives `normaliseClientError` with `code`, `httpStatus` and the field entry intact.
- `form-server-field-errors.test.tsx`: a rejected submit marks the `sku` input (`aria-invalid`, sentence under it, no toast); without `field` the toast carries the generic sentence and no input is marked.

## Acceptance notes

- `ApiDataSource`, which embeds the body as a JSON tail in the message string, is not read for `field`; the ObjectStack adapter is the console's path.
